title: Norwegian Woods
description:
#summit26 [Welded Woodlands] (MC-Name: MusicAphi)
Here is my Submission. Inspired by the image I thought about the Snowy Taiga, and Scandinavic Countries. The piece begins with arpeggiated runs, symboling a dense forrest covered in snow, which is moving through the air. The fanfare, is inspired by Viking-Calls. The is also a deep "bell"-Sound, this sound is a person using an anvil to forge something. The is also a part, that represents a "traditional-song", that the vikings sung (not based on a real piece).

The whole thing is pretty vanilla, except for some deep Bass Sound, that are below the normal Range, and the Custom: block.portal.trigger-Sound (which I found in the NBS-Sounds folder) used as transition.
